id: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me (1999)

vibe.verdict: Every quote checks out and the board is packed with the film's best bits (Belgian Dip, Alan Parsons Project, Diet Coke of evil, chicken in bed), on a loud 60s card that suits it.
missing: One million dollars, pinky to the lip (Dr. Evil, 1969 lair)
Scott and the 'shh' routine on the Jerry Springer show
ideas: Swap the footer 'Cover charge after nine.' for 'Cover charge: one million dollars.'
Note: the Fat Bastard line is said to Mini-Me in Dr. Evil's lair, not at the party, so the 'Overheard at the party' heading is a stretch
